name: @blueriverlhr/dsh-coteam
description: dsh-coteam monorepo meta package: distributed collaboration team agent presets for the dsh web GUI. Aggregates the preset subpackage (team-leader 小组长模式 + team-member 小组成员模式) and the skills subpackage (grill-me and more). Install this meta bundle to get everything; each subpackage is also installable on its own.
